summary: This Standards Track document allocates TLS code points so client certificates can use RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5 signatures in TLS 1.3. This removes an obstacle for some deployments moving to TLS 1.3.

eli5.summary: Some old ID cards only work with an old kind of scanner. This adds the old scanner setting back so those cards still work with the new system.

questions: rsa pkcs1 v1.5 client certificates tls 1.3
